name: Total Drivetrain Loss Structural Composition
description: Total drivetrain power loss is structurally composed from motor iron loss, gearbox friction loss, and differential bearing loss — three independent uncertainty sources summed.

consistency_relations.upr_description: Structural UPR: total drivetrain loss CZ is Minkowski sum of three independent loss component CZs.
